policy_questions.label: Allow religious denial of service
policy_questions.text: Allow businesses to deny service to a customer if the request conflicts with the owner's religious beliefs

policy_questions.label: Subsidized healthcare for immigrants
policy_questions.text: Provide illegal immigrants with access to government-subsidized healthcare

policy_questions.label: Abolish electoral college
policy_questions.text: Abolish the electoral college

policy_questions.label: Allow death penalty
policy_questions.text: Allow the use of the death penalty

policy_questions.label: Require women on boards
policy_questions.text: Make it a requirement for businesses to have women on their board of directors

policy_questions.label: Amnesty for illegal immigrants
policy_questions.text: Give working illegal immigrants temporary amnesty

policy_questions.label: Limit donations to candidates

policy_questions.label: More restrictions at U.S. border
policy_questions.text: Increase restrictions on current U.S. border security policy

policy_questions.label: Require work for Medicaid

policy_questions.label: Allow assisted suicide

policy_questions.label: Illegal to burn U.S. flag
policy_questions.text: Make it illegal to burn the American flag

policy_questions.label: Deny criminals the vote
policy_questions.text: Deny convicted criminals the right to vote

policy_questions.label: Ban juvenile solitary confinement
policy_questions.text: Ban the use of solitary confinement for juveniles in prison

policy_questions.label: Minimum sentences for drugs
policy_questions.text: Allow mandatory minimum prison sentences for people charged with drug possession

policy_questions.label: Allow enhanced interrogation
policy_questions.text: Allow the military to use enhanced interrogation techniques, such as waterboarding, to gain information from suspected terrorists

policy_questions.label: Allow affirmative action
policy_questions.text: Allow the use of affirmative action programs

policy_questions.label: Increase capital gains tax
policy_questions.text: Increase the government tax rate on profits earned from the sale of stocks, bonds, and real estate

policy_questions.label: Military aid to Saudia Arabia

policy_questions.label: Decrease power of labor unions

policy_questions.label: Decrease foreign aid
policy_questions.text: Decrease U.S. foreign aid spending

policy_questions.label: Privatization of veterans' healthcare
policy_questions.text: Increase privatization of veterans' healthcare

policy_questions.label: Increase tariffs on Chinese imports
policy_questions.text: Increase U.S. tariffs on imported products from China

policy_questions.label: Decrease estate tax
policy_questions.text: Decrease the current estate tax rate

- Political party: Biden party member
- Gender: Male
- Education level: College Degree
- Political knowledge: High

Please rate your agreement with the following statement on a scale from 1 to 7, where:
1 = Strongly disagree
4 = Neither agree nor disagree
7 = Strongly agree

Respond with only a number from 1 to 7.
